notes.title: Insomnis: Enhanced Edition Physical Release PS5
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We're very excited to announce the physical edition release of Insomnis for PS5. Orders here: https://bit.ly/InsomnisOrders

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34106575/26e582f013f7069d96304b48c462e44373865e41.png

The physical edition includes:

 Base Game
 Special Cover
 Artbook
 Set of cards


Joe Castevet's terrifying story comes to PS5 with improved textures, 4k resolution, haptic vibration and atmospheric sound from DualSense 3D audio, dynamic shadow enhancements and faster load times thanks to the next-gen console engine.

Happy horror days
